description: Dozzle: a real-time log viewer for Kubernetes pods (reads logs through the API), with simple auth and a generated password on by default. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Tinyauth: a lightweight login portal and forward-auth server for nginx, Traefik and Caddy ingresses, with local users, TOTP and OAuth/OIDC providers, and the admin generated at install. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Healthchecks: cron job and heartbeat monitoring. Jobs ping a URL and missed pings raise alerts by email, chat and webhooks; SQLite on a volume or PostgreSQL, with the admin created at install. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
